name: Vechny
source:
"Eternal" is a story about a new vision of the camp's world, its inhabitants, but most of all, of those who hide behind its scenes.
It is a meditative tale about those thrown into a hopeless place, which they would try to resist, inevitably lose to, and be forced to accept.
It is an unpleasant story about suffering, despair, and actions that a person wouldn't even want to think about.
It is a pleasantly spent time with a wonderful catgirl companion.
It is a spirit raised in the name of a great goal.
It is newfound abilities that ruin everything, and weaknesses that actually help.
It is an influx of mixed and oppressive feelings, heavy and repulsive thoughts, obsessive actions, and an unhealthy desire to achieve goals unknown even to oneself.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1707032907]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《永恒》是一个关于集中营世界、集中营居民、但最重要的是那些隐藏在幕后的人们的新视野的故事。
这是一个关于那些被扔进绝望境地的人的冥想故事，他们试图抵抗，不可避免地失败，然后被迫接受。
这是一个关于痛苦、绝望和人们甚至不愿去想的行为的不愉快的故事。
与美妙的猫女同伴一起度过了一段愉快的时光。
这是一种以伟大目标为名的精神。
新发现的能力会毁掉一切，而弱点却能真正起到帮助作用。
它是一种复杂而压抑的感觉、沉重而令人厌恶的想法、强迫性的行为以及一种不健康的欲望的涌入，这种欲望甚至是为了实现自己都不知道的目标。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1707032907]Steam[/url]]
